title: top Paying for ChatGPT   This FREE AI Just Took the #1 Spot for Coding #shorts  #ai #chatgpt
description:
Are you still paying monthly subscriptions for ChatGPT or Claude to write your code? You might want to pause those payments. There is a new, completely free AI model that just took the top spot for coding.

In this video, I break down Kimi K3, an incredible new model launched by Moonshot AI that is already outperforming some of the biggest AI models on major coding benchmarks.

Here is why Kimi K3 is an absolute game-changer:

Users are utilizing a single prompt to build fully playable 3D games, interactive websites, research dashboards, and full applications.

In one impressive demo, someone drew a cowboy on a piece of paper, and Kimi K3 turned it into a complete 3D game.

This AI-generated game included a day and night cycle, weather, reflections, and a fully playable character.

The AI even found a bug during gameplay and automatically fixed the code by itself.

Moonshot is releasing Kimi K3 as an open model, which allows developers, students, and founders to build with frontier-level artificial intelligence without having to pay for premium coding tools.

This release is a massive sign that the AI race is getting much bigger and more competitive than just OpenAI and Anthropic.
